master.pipeline: resonance.studio.pipeline.master_signal (intake pass, gemini-still-water), executed by master_still_water.py in this directory; the delivered files were re-measured from disk after the strike
notes: loudness is K-weighted integrated, UNGATED (BS.1770 gating omitted in the house scales, stated not hidden).

the ceiling did not have to win: the -0.9 dB loudness gain alone brought the true peak to -1.03 dBTP, under the -1.0 ceiling, so the trim is 0.0 dB and ceiling_overrode_loudness is false in the pipeline's own report.

no head or tail fades: an intake master of a finished render leaves the waveform's edges as struck. The strike's own fade (programme above -40 dBFS to 157.75 s, final window -111.0 dBFS, exact zeros only in the last 0.6 s of the fade and 0.03 s of decoder head) is the performance's, untouched.

nothing else rides and nothing was removed: no EQ, no width process, no edit of any kind between decode and the loudness/ceiling law — the one addition is the confessed Sigma fixture in the sigma block.

sigma.added_by: the desk, at the strike of the master, 2026-11-10
sigma.authority: the brief's own order (a binaural Sigma layer embedded through the track) + the founder's embedded-Sigma standing order + the closed Fixtures A/B law (ear verdict 2026-11-10: a house Sigma pair may ride a Gemini master — studio-runs/gemini-hood-elegance/fixtures-ab/)
sigma.basis_in_the_strike: the strike's own ordered layer read NOT CERTIFIABLE by both probes (analysis-stats.json). Fixed seats at the doctrine pair: L @ 200 Hz median 2.49 dB, persistence 0.263; R @ 213 Hz median 4.78 dB, persistence 0.350 — the bar is >= 10 dB median AND >= 0.90 persistence in BOTH channels. Pair tracker: pair persistence 0.962 and median line ratios 16.72 dB (L) / 16.94 dB (R), but median interaural difference 0.0 Hz, IQR 2.5 Hz, and 0.0 % of pair windows inside 13-31 Hz or within 13 +/- 2 Hz — the tracked lines are the programme's own centred tones, identical in both ears, the same species as the Honey and Hammer strike.
sigma.confession: what rides is the house Proven Road pair — a CONSTANT 200/213 Hz pair beating at 13.0 Hz — the only Sigma form the house has proven. It fulfils the brief's ordered constant 13 Hz beat in seat and rate; it does not pretend the strike performed its own layer, which both probes read as absent at mastering depth.
sigma.recipe: the house Proven Road fixture, exactly as the prior Gemini masters rode it: constant sine pair, 200 Hz left / 213 Hz right (13.0 Hz binaural beat), amplitude = mastered-bed RMS x 10^(-28/20); mastered bed RMS 0.1746, pair amplitude 0.00695

residual_verification.method: fixtures method, run at the strike of the master: final minus pre-ride master is the Sigma layer alone, sample-aligned; per-window FFT peaks in 180-230 Hz read the pair at its seats. Peak-picking the mix itself would find the programme's tones, not the pair.
residual_verification.reading: every one of the 81 probed windows reads the pair at its seats; the residual's RMS (0.004915) equals the pair's own sine RMS (amplitude/sqrt(2) = 0.004914), i.e. the delivered master differs from the pre-Sigma master by the confessed fixture and by nothing else above 24-bit quantisation dust.

sigma.trim_after_ride: none applied and none needed: loudness measured -14.0 LUFS before the ride and -14.0 LUFS after it (the pair's contribution is below the manifest's 0.01 LU resolution).

verification.measured_by: the intake desk, from the delivered WAV on disk (house pipeline estimator), 2026-11-10

width.reason: no stems exist; the lead voices ride the mid and bleed into what side signal there is, so any widening available to this desk would move the vocal image with the bed. The side-RMS change (-26.23 to -27.11) is the -0.9 dB master gain plus the ride's small side contribution, not a width process.
